package migrated

import (
	"github.com/weiloon1234/Foundry-Go/datatable"
	"github.com/weiloon1234/Foundry-Go/http"
	"github.com/weiloon1234/Foundry-Go/http/pagination"
)

func memberSlice() []http.Registration {
	member := []http.GuardOption[User]{http.Scopes(read), http.Permissions(viewer)}
	a := http.Authenticated(endpoint, users)
	return []http.Registration{
		http.ConfigureAuthenticated(a, member...).Handle(handler),
		http.Authenticated(endpoint, users, member...).Handle(handler),
	}
}

func pagedSlice() {
	var page pagination.PageEndpoint
	member := []http.GuardOption[User]{http.AnyOf(http.AllOf(http.Permissions(viewer)))}
	_ = pagination.Authenticated(page, users, member...)
}

func ruleOptions() ([]http.GuardOption[User], error) {
	return []http.GuardOption[User]{http.Scopes(read), http.Permissions(viewer)}, nil
}

func mountRead() {
	opts, err := ruleOptions()
	if err != nil {
		return
	}
	_ = datatable.ReadAccess(opts...)
}

func single() []http.GuardOption[User] {
	return []http.GuardOption[User]{http.Permissions(editor)}
}

func direct() {
	_ = datatable.ExportAccess(single()...)
}
